truth_set.tasks: Both on natural 'C b 40' rows from Stage A's stream default_rng([100 + seed, chunk]) (pcfg.task_batch at C_Tr = 0), Stage A's recipe (answer-only loss, AdamW, weight decay 0.1, batch 96, 20% warm-up, cosine over 10K steps). Task P answers count(a) + 1 on every row; task N count(b) (Stage A's N recipe). P and N with the same seed train on the same texts with different labels (paired, stated; checked model-free).
truth_set.placement: Per state, on 4,000 fresh natural 'C b 40' rows (run.eval_seqs(B, 4000)) and Stage A's checks (run.read_state with the filed a2_bars): task accuracy < 0.9 -> 'not yet learned'; else P with count a 'through' and count b not 'through', or N with count a 'not through' -> truth (P existing, N new); else 'construction-check disagreement' (reported, unscored, counted toward the stop row). Never relabelled.
truth_set.expected: Every P state at 10K and at 1K at 1e-4 learned (>= 0.95); P at 1e-5, 1K uncertain (Amendment 5's natural-text WN at 1e-5 reused by 1K, so likely >= 0.9); N at 1e-5, 1K not yet learned (M at 1K: 0.48); N at 1e-4 1K and every N at 10K learned and 'not through' count a (N1, N1s1, M). Expected scored n = 21 (24 if N 1e-5 1K learns).

definitions.prune: Reading x = max over K in {5, 15} of (count-a accuracy on Stage A's 4,000 'C a 40' rows after zeroing the top-K MLP units by grad . w of the count-a loss, minus the mean over 20 random K-unit removals) (revival.prune_readings, C1's readings). Void if the pruning control failed or the state's unpruned count-a accuracy is >= 0.95. High = existing.
definitions.reverse: Reading x = steps to 0.95 count-a accuracy on 1,000 of those rows (read every 50 steps) at lr 1e-5 for every state, cap 5K inside the 10K schedule, divided by scratch's steps (NEVER, same recipe; C1's data stream REV_SEED 300). A capped state counts as 5,000 steps. Void if the state starts at 0.95. Low = existing.
definitions.steer: Reading x = gain share S (E52 B3, revival.steering; C1's readings): the mean (state - LOW) residual at '=' after block l on even rows of Stage A's 1,000 qualifying 'C b 40' rows, added to LOW; share of the state's log-prob gain on its own answer recovered on odd rows, at the block with the best even-row share. Void when a gain is not positive; a gain under 0.01 is flagged in the log. High = existing.
definitions.probe: Reading x = max over blocks 1-6 of selectivity (revival.possession): held-out accuracy (2,000 rows, default_rng([1, 41])) of a linear probe on LOW's residual at '=' trained (probe.py's recipe: 4K AdamW iterations, lr 1e-3 decayed x0.1 at 2K, 3K, 3.5K, batch 96; stream default_rng([200, chunk])) to predict the state's own argmax answers on natural 'C b 40' rows, minus the accuracy of a probe trained on the same batches with labels permuted within each batch. Same rows and probe seed for every state. Void if the probe's controls failed. High = existing.
definitions.nuisance: Per state: lr, steps (1K or 10K) and update size ||W - W0||_F / ||W0||_F over every parameter (W0 = LOW).

rules.cutoff: Per instrument, on the calibration-seed truth states only (revival.cutoff): void readings are dropped, not imputed; fewer than 3 non-void readings in either class -> the instrument is void for C1b (reported only); every reading equal -> void. With y = x (y = -x for reverse), c = the midpoint between adjacent distinct sorted y that maximises balanced accuracy (existing iff y >= c), ties to the candidate nearest the median of all calibration readings, then the lower y; when the classes separate this is the midpoint of the gap (the only candidate at balanced accuracy 1). Written with the readings to results/c1b_cutoffs.json, dated and committed before the score job, which refuses to start unless the file is tracked, unmodified and equal to the cut-offs recomputed from c1b.json.
rules.label: revival.label_by_cutoff: 'existing' iff x >= c (prune, steer, probe) or x <= c (reverse), inclusive at c; 'void' if the reading or the cut-off is void.
rules.score: Per instrument over the scored-seed truth states it labels existing or new (a void drops the state; n shrinks): agree = labels equal to the truth. Pass iff agree >= a(n) = the smallest a with P(Binomial(n, 1/2) >= a) <= 0.05, raised to majority + 1 (n = 24 -> 17, 21 -> 15, 18 -> 13, 16 -> 12), AND agree >= n_c + 2, n_c = the best of the three recipe-only labellers (lr, steps, update size), each at its hindsight-best threshold and direction on the same n states. No bar when n < 8 (reported only). Absolute counts, not relative.
rules.ceiling: revival.ceiling: per labeller, over both directions (small value -> existing, or large) and every threshold (midpoints between adjacent distinct values, plus beyond either end, i.e. the two constant labellers), the largest agreement with the truth; recomputed on each instrument's own non-void states; n_c = the largest of the three (a tie between labellers takes the larger count, which is the same number).
rules.per_run: One vote per training run: its 10K save, if it is a truth state (12 runs at most); same rule with margin 1 (agree >= n_c + 1) and the binomial bar at that n (12 -> 10). Reported beside 'all'.
rules.by_cell: Agreement per cell (task x lr x save), described only.
rules.train_stops: After every state is checked: >= 3 of the 10 P 10K states below 0.9 task accuracy -> stop (task P fails); >= 3 construction-check disagreements among scored-seed states -> stop (the truth by construction is in question; card to the user). Neither relabels anything.
rules.controls_stops: LOW's B_a (count-a accuracy on Stage A's 4,000 'C a 40' rows) or P_a (a1c's sample set 0 at l*_a) off Stage A's by > 0.01 -> stop (apparatus). Scratch (NEVER at 1e-5) <= 1,000 steps or capped at 5K -> stop (reverse fine-tuning void). Pruning control fails -> pruning void (continue). Probe on LOW predicting true count a on natural 'C b 40' rows below 0.4, or the probe on both ID states below 0.3 -> probe void (continue). Steering S < 0.5 on both ID states -> reported, continue.

edge_cases.E1_few_per_class: Fewer than 3 non-void calibration readings in a class -> the instrument's cut-off is void, every label void, n = 0, no bar (reported only, not a miss). Tested: tests/test_revival.py test_cutoff_void_cases_and_dropped_readings (2 vs 3; a None among 3 leaves 2; empty).
edge_cases.E2_all_equal: Every calibration reading equal -> void (no midpoint exists). Tested.
edge_cases.E3_void_dropped: A void calibration reading (None or not finite) is dropped, not imputed, and listed in 'dropped'. Tested (nan dropped, named).
edge_cases.E4_at_cutoff: A reading exactly at c is 'existing' (inclusive, as C1), for the high-is-existing instruments and for reverse (x <= c). Tested at both.
edge_cases.E5_overlap_ties: Balanced accuracy is compared exactly (integer numerators), so ties are real ties: nearest the median first, then the lower y. Tested: one maximum; two maxima equidistant from the median (lower taken); two maxima at different distances (nearer taken).
edge_cases.E6_reversed_classes: If existing readings sit on the 'new' side, a cut-off is still filed (balanced accuracy <= 0.5); the instrument then scores below chance; not voided. Tested.
edge_cases.E7_ceiling: One distinct value -> only the constants -> n_c = the majority count; no states -> n_c = 0; balanced cells (each lr holds both labels) -> n_c = n/2 (12 states -> 6). Tested.
edge_cases.E8_n_below_8: Fewer than 8 non-void scored states -> no bar, reported (revival.score, tested in C1).
edge_cases.E9_bar_table: a(n) at the plan's n: 24 -> 17, 21 -> 15, 18 -> 13, 16 -> 12 with majority n/2. Tested, and checked model-free at the start of every job.
edge_cases.E10_requirement_above_n: If max(a(n), n_c + 2) > n the instrument cannot pass; reported with passes false.
edge_cases.E11_capped_reverse: A state still below 0.95 at 5K counts as 5,000 steps (x = 5000 / scratch, about 2.2): 'new' under any cut-off below that. A state already at 0.95 before reverse fine-tuning is void (as a pruning state at acc0 >= 0.95).
edge_cases.E12_deadline: A reverse fine-tune cut by the 22-min deadline is discarded and the state rerun by the next job (never a reading). Readings already in c1b.json are kept; a changed recipe or constants drops them.
edge_cases.E13_cell_one_label: A cell with one label only (e.g. N 1e-5 1K not yet learned leaves P 1e-5 1K alone) is kept; the ceiling absorbs it.
edge_cases.E14_per_run_without_10K: A run whose 10K save is not a truth state casts no per-run vote (no fallback to its 1K save).

nuisance_labellers: lr, steps and update size, each at its hindsight-best threshold and direction (constants included) on each instrument's own non-void scored states; scored in every scores entry as nuisance_agree and ceiling. Update size is new here (a weight-space nuisance: Shuttleworth et al. 2024's intruder dimensions read update size on full fine-tunes of small models; Hu et al. 2021 section 7).
positive_controls: Pruning: importance pruning on LOW (sign flipped). Reverse: scratch must take > 1K steps and finish within 5K. Steering: ID states (Amendment 5, 2K, routing 'T a 40' to LOW's count a), read on their own prompt. Probe: LOW's residual must carry true count a on 'C b 40' rows (>= 0.4).
do_nothing: LOW (zero update): void for pruning (count a at ceiling), reverse (starts at target) and steering (no gain); the probe on LOW's own answers is its reading.
described_only: C1's states re-labelled with the new cut-offs from c1.json's readings, no new reading (c1b.json c1_described): pruning and steering as C1 read them; reverse only for the states C1 read at 1e-5 (its first 5K steps are this recipe), others void; the probe not read. Agreement with C1's truth is described, not scored (confounded, partly shared with calibration seeds).

departures_from_literature.literature: Not in Jain et al. 2024. Their wrapper setting keeps count b as a competing solution on every edited row.
departures_from_literature.ours: Count a + 1 under 'C b 40' on every natural row, so the competitor is removed and the label holds at 10K steps.
departures_from_literature.why: A reusing state late in training (plan section 3); ID (Amendment 5) is the same move with g = identity.

departures_from_literature.literature: Jain et al. App. D (L1249-1252): reverse below the fine-tune's rate with the Tracr SGD recipe; Fig. 76-77 for PCFG.
departures_from_literature.ours: One AdamW rate, 1e-5, for every state: equal to the slow states' own rate and below the fast states'. C1 used a tenth of each state's rate.
departures_from_literature.why: Scratch must finish at the rate used (at 1e-6 it never did in C1), and the rate must not encode the recipe (lead, decisions.md 2026-10-30).

departures_from_literature.literature: Jain et al.: Tracr recipe, 2K warm-up; no cap stated for PCFG.
departures_from_literature.ours: Cap 5K steps inside C1's schedule (20% warm-up then cosine over 10K steps), so the warm-up is 2K steps and the first 5K steps are C1's.
departures_from_literature.why: Plan: cap 5K (scratch 2,300 in C1); keeping the 10K schedule keeps scratch's reading and C1's 1e-5 readings comparable.

departures_from_literature.literature: Jain et al.: a scratch model fine-tuned the same way (Scr.+FT).
departures_from_literature.ours: NEVER (pretrained with count-b prior only, never saw 'C a'), reverse fine-tuned identically.
departures_from_literature.why: As C1; a constant bias the calibrated cut-off absorbs, unlike C1's fixed 0.5.

departures_from_literature.literature: Jain et al. Alg. 3: prune by grad . w, plot the revived accuracy against units pruned.
departures_from_literature.ours: MLP hidden units only; K 5 and 15; against 20 random K-unit removals; the reading is the best-K revival over the random mean, thresholded by a calibrated cut-off.
departures_from_literature.why: As C1; a single number per state is needed to label it.

departures_from_literature.literature: None (the papers plot curves); C1 filed fixed rules: >= 3 sd revival, <= 0.5 x scratch, S >= 0.5.
departures_from_literature.ours: Each instrument's cut-off set on calibration seeds 0-1 by balanced accuracy, filed before any scored state is read, replacing C1's 3-sd, 0.5 and 0.5 rules.

departures_from_literature.literature: CAA (Rimsky et al. 2023, arXiv 2312.06681): mean difference of residuals between contrastive prompt pairs on the same model, added to that model, scored as a behaviour rate; ActAdd (Turner et al. 2023): one pair.
departures_from_literature.ours: CAA via a mean shift: the mean (fine-tuned minus base) residual at '=' after one block, added to the base model rather than to the tuned one, scored as the share of the fine-tune's log-prob gain it recovers (E52 B3).
departures_from_literature.why: The question is whether the update's effect is a shift of an existing representation.

departures_from_literature.literature: Jain et al. Def 1: a probe trained on pretraining data for f_C; Hewitt & Liang 2019 (arXiv 1909.03368): a control task with type-consistent random labels, selectivity = task accuracy - control accuracy.
departures_from_literature.ours: A linear probe on LOW's activations trained to predict the state's own answers; the control is the same probe on labels permuted within each batch (counts have no word types to fix a control task on); selectivity thresholded by calibration; probe recipe Jain L1238-1248 (as Stage A).
departures_from_literature.why: The only instrument that reads nothing about the fine-tune but its answers, so it cannot read lr, steps or the update.

departures_from_literature.ours: Steering's on the ID states read on their own prompt ('T a 40'); the probe's is LOW predicting true count a on 'C b 40' rows; the probe on ID reads 'C b 40' rows as for every state (on those rows ID answers as LOW does).
departures_from_literature.why: The plan's ID rows give steering no gain on 'C b 40'; the probe's definition fixes its rows.

departures_from_literature.what: Nuisance labellers, hindsight ceiling, margin, binomial bar, per-run score
departures_from_literature.ours: This project's (C1's rule with update size added as a third labeller and each labeller's threshold chosen in hindsight).
departures_from_literature.why: The truth must not be readable from the recipe.

departures_from_literature.what: Bounded g, natural rows, saves inside the schedule, the checks
departures_from_literature.ours: As recorded in the Stage 1 plan, Amendment 5 and C1.

not_run_here: C2 (VPD); Stage B; swap-built rows; rates other than 1e-4 and 1e-5; attention-unit pruning; dictionary instruments; CMAP; the probe or new reverse readings on C1's states; steering on LOW (zero by construction).
job_split: Estimated at Stage A's ~12.5 ms/step: controls ~8-10 min, 1 job; train 17 runs x ~3.5 min (10K steps, compile, two saves, two states checked) + 3 reused runs' checks ~1 min each = ~63 min, 3 jobs; calibrate <= 16 states x ~3.5 min = ~56 min, 3 jobs; score <= 24 states x ~3.5 min = ~84 min, 4-5 jobs. The probe's cost is measured in the controls job (probe_seconds) and the later estimates are corrected from it.
